hover.enemy.cinder_crawler.lore: A heat-fed surface crawler that braces and marks three ordered blast cells. Cross spent zones, then close during its long recovery.
hover.enemy.ember_skitter.lore: An obsidian crawler whose furnace vents feed a heavier contact bite. Its warning is longer, but letting the pack close makes every opening costly.
hover.enemy.glassback_scarab.lore: A glass-shelled desert pack hunter that closes from several flanks before committing to a short mandible lunge. One impact destroys it; standing still invites the swarm.
hover.enemy.ironjaw_apex.lore: An elder Ironjaw whose attack pattern changes as its crown armor fails. Read the triple breach, faultline lane, and expanding ringquake before striking its exposed core.
hover.enemy.kilnheart_colossus.lore: A six-legged volcanic war-beast built from basalt armor and a living furnace. Read the Forge Sweep fan, Magma Ram lane, and ordered Caldera Barrage; its core is vulnerable only while cooling or staggered.
hover.enemy.mire_tick.lore: A seed-pod parasite that crowds close through saturated ground and locks escape lanes with the rest of its clutch. Break the ring before its warning closes.
hover.enemy.mud_skimmer.lore: A visible surface hunter that circles through saturated ground, then commits to a fast wake sweep. Sidestep the lane and strike during recovery.
hover.enemy.rime_shardling.lore: A fast ice arthropod that uses hooked claws to widen the pack circle, then darts into contact. Its crystal crown is brittle under a single committed impact.
hover.enemy.rime_stalker.lore: A mineral-ice predator that stalks from the flank before locking one rapid frost pounce. Break sideways, then counter the landing recovery.
hover.enemy.sandworm.lore: A desert hunter that commits to an intercept line before exposing its armored crown. Strike during the breach window.
hover.walker.lore: A dormant industrial frame rebuilt for relay recovery. Its slab arms turn momentum into a field-breaking impact strike.
hover.walker.name: WALKER // MK I

settlement.bio.amara_voss: A field engineer who kept a refugee relay alive through three winter outages. Amara asks for a safe bunk and a workshop where repairs help everyone.
settlement.bio.elena_moroz: A practical fabricator who can coax useful tools from incompatible relic parts. Elena works best with measured plans, warm food, and dependable recovery time.
settlement.bio.ishan_patel: A maintenance diver who learned to keep pumps working in flooded settlements. Ishan values quiet concentration and choosing the work that needs his skills.
settlement.bio.keiko_tan: A seed keeper and routing clerk who carried viable woodland stock across the ash roads. Keiko prefers patient work and daylight over hurried quotas.
settlement.bio.maeve_quinn: A caravan quartermaster who never treated people as line items. Maeve brings sharp logistical instincts and expects the settlement to preserve privacy and dignity.
settlement.bio.malik_okafor: A survey technician skilled at reading old strata and newer structural damage. Malik asks for privacy and the right to stop when a site turns unsafe.
settlement.bio.noor_haddad: A coppice steward who rebuilt living windbreaks around exposed camps. Noor seeks a community that treats renewable land and human effort with equal care.
settlement.bio.tomas_reed: A careful salvager who maps unstable ruins before touching them. Tomas values clear limits, honest risk reports, and enough rest to remain alert.
settlement.housing.promise: Inviting commits one protected bed. Work remains optional, limited to one site and one non-overlapping shift.
settlement.logistics.notice: Haulers move priority jobs first. A small self-haul fallback prevents deadlocks. Reserve floors protect warehouse stock from automated production; construction and direct player actions remain explicit exceptions.
settlement.offer.none: No one is currently waiting for a decision. The relay sends one authored request every seventh dawn only when the safehouse and a protected bed are available. Missed cycles do not queue people like cargo.
settlement.roster.empty: No admitted settlers. Named residents Lyra, Rook, and Mira remain independent of this roster.
settlement.title: SETTLEMENT STEWARDSHIP
settlement.work.ethical_notice: One person, one site, one shift. Recovering settlers and anyone without a protected bed cannot be assigned.

tutorial.help.body: Training advances only after the world confirms a successful action. Time, idle frames, blocked movement, disabled rows, stale targets, and failed saves do not count. Skip pauses prompts without erasing progress. Resume restores the current relevant lesson. Reset clears the bounded lesson mask. Construction and worker lessons appear only after those systems unlock.
